t: This is Putney Park House, a Grade II listed house at 69 Pleasance Road in Roehampton. It was designed by Decimus Burton, one of the foremost English architects of the nineteenth century, known for Roman Revival, Greek Revival and Regency styles, and for designing the Athenaeum Club. The house is also where Anna Larpent died in 1832. She was a diarist whose seventeen volumes cover forty-seven years of Georgian life, from 1773 to 1830, and she also helped review plays for the Examiner of Plays.
